about: The Australian dollar's FX settlement calendar (Sydney): NSW public holidays and the NSW Bank Holiday, 1990-2100. ANZ: national holidays close the banks, and the NSW holidays (King's Birthday, the August Bank Holiday, Labour Day) are also non-business days for AUD FX. New Year's Day, Australia Day, Christmas and Boxing Day on a weekend move to the following Monday (Christmas and Boxing Day to the Monday and Tuesday); Good Friday and Easter Monday; Anzac Day stays on April 25 even on a weekend. The Bank Holiday (first Monday in August) isn't a declared public holiday but closes the banks (Retail Trading Act 2008, Part 3A). Anzac Day on Easter Monday is one day, and in 2011 the Tuesday was a substitute public holiday for Easter Monday (an exception here: whether that recurs in 2095 is left open). One-offs: the National Day of Mourning for Queen Elizabeth II (2022-09-22: Sydney and Melbourne banks closed, per ISDA) and the extra Anzac Day Mondays of 2026 and 2027 (Public Holidays Amendment (Anzac Day) Order 2026, those two years only; RITS Advice 02/2026: no CLS settlement). Before 1994 Australia Day was a long-weekend Monday, taken here as the Monday on or after January 26 (WA's 1992 statement: 1993's was February 1); unchecked for NSW. Checked against ANZ's 2024, 2025 and 2026 lists and NSW's 2026-2027 list; other years are the rules unchecked against a published list.

exceptions.holiday: National Day of Mourning (Queen Elizabeth II)
Easter Monday (substitute: Easter Monday was Anzac Day)
